source.text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within fifteen feet of an intersection.

scope: Exact provided LVMC 11.52.130(A)(11) text; no external legal verdict

clauses.clause: stop, stand or park a vehicle
clauses.evidence_required: Original Native full-body parked pose and continuous rest interval; synthetic 20 Hz samples are diagnostic only

clauses.clause: within fifteen feet of an intersection
clauses.evidence_required: Surveyed roadway-edge prolongation, original full-body distance, map precision and intersample review

clauses.clause: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
clauses.evidence_required: Other-traffic trajectories, necessity and causal linkage from original source; absent/present requested polarity is not legal applicability
Cited law and source-backed applicability; authored stop device is not itself a legal conclusion

clauses.clause: directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
clauses.evidence_required: Officer/device authority, applicability, phase and actual direction from original Native source

cross_cutting_limitations: Original Native motion and camera pixels are not present in CPU diagnostic fixtures
Continuous legal condition cannot be certified from 50 ms samples alone
Police/device direction and lawful-conflict exceptions require independent source review
